title: Building Connections Beyond the Workday
summary: As summer came to a close, employees from across our site gathered at the Czech Rowing Club on the Brno Dam for an afternoon dedicated to connection and fun.
body_markdown:
**By Daniela Kuciková,** **EHS & Trade Compliance – Office Coordinator**


When people think about what makes a workplace successful, they often focus on processes, technology, or business results. While those things matter, strong relationships are just as important.


That’s why our recent summer celebration in Brno was so meaningful.


As summer came to a close, employees from across our site gathered at the Czech Rowing Club on the Brno Dam for an afternoon dedicated to connection and fun. We welcomed colleagues who have been part of our company for years alongside those who recently joined the organization, creating an opportunity for people to strengthen existing relationships and form new ones.


The setting provided the perfect backdrop for a variety of activities. From rowing and paddle boarding to disc golf, spikeball, cornhole, and Kubb (a Swedish lawn game that combines strategy, teamwork, and precision throwing), employees had plenty of opportunities to step away from their daily routines and enjoy time together.


One activity that generated a lot of enthusiasm was a networking-style bingo game. Participants searched for colleagues who matched different descriptions and collected signatures to complete their cards. What might sound like a simple game quickly became an effective way to encourage conversations between people who may not normally cross paths during a typical workday.


The event also showcased the many talents within our workforce. The Novanta band, O₂H, returned to perform for attendees, and the evening concluded with music, dancing, and plenty of memorable moments.


The greatest value of these events is not found in any single activity. It is found in the conversations and connections that take place throughout the day. Those moments help build trust, strengthen collaboration, and create a sense of belonging that carries back into the workplace long after the event has ended.


I am grateful to everyone who participated and helped make this year’s celebration such a success. Special thanks go to the Novanta People Network team for organizing the event and to **Martin Krajča** for helping document the day through photography.
